current_answer: As checked on October 17, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found; two earlier official target movements remain relevant to uncertainty. Rockstar’s October 15 launch trailer confirms active promotion, not build completion. No official native PC version, date, or window has been announced. GamesBeat reported a Q1 2027 PC plan based on four anonymous sources; follow-up coverage checked traces to that report and is not independent confirmation. This is relevant to PC-first buyers but does not change the official console commitment. A separate anonymous full-build threat is financially incentivized and unverified; no independent verification of a complete build was found.

catalogue_card.question: Does the Q1 2027 PC report mean GTA 6 is confirmed for PC by March?
catalogue_card.text: No. GamesBeat reported a Q1 2027 plan from four anonymous sources, but Rockstar and Take-Two have not announced a PC version or date. Follow-up coverage repeats the GamesBeat report and is not independent confirmation.
